class.name: PhysXGroundGrains3D
class.brief_description: Sand thrown out of a [GroundSurface3D] as grains that land back in it.
class.description: The hybrid of a height field and particles of Holz, Beer and Kuhlen (2009): the [GroundSurface3D] field is the sand at rest; where a spinning wheel throws its tread's sand (the ground's sprays, from [PhysXVehicle3D] on soft soil) or a script calls [method kick], that volume is dug out of the field and flies as MPM grains (Drucker-Prager, inherited from [PhysXGranular3D]). A grain that comes down onto the field's surface is deposited back into its column and the field slumps it; one leaving the box flies on ballistically to where it lands. Volume is kept end to end: [method get_dug_volume] equals [method get_airborne_volume] plus [method get_deposited_volume]. Thrown grains fly ballistic (no settling damping above about 1 m/s) and are stepped on the physics tick. Each particle stands for about 3 cl of sand and is drawn as a loose cloud of fine specks, so a spray reads as a sheet of sand. The box (8 x 4 x 10 m at 6.25 cm cells) follows [member follow_target] and reaches the way the sand is thrown.

method.name: get_airborne_positions
method.description: Where the grains in the air were last read back (a frame or two behind the solver).

method.name: get_airborne_volume
method.description: The sand in the air, m3 (including dug sand not yet a whole grain).

method.name: get_deposited_volume
method.description: The sand landed back in the ground so far, m3.

method.name: get_dug_volume
method.description: The sand taken out of the ground so far, m3.

method.name: get_mud_grains
method.description: The internal grains node of wet clay this node throws sticky sprays with, or [code]null[/code] (see [member mud_spray]).

method.name: get_stuck_volume
method.description: Of [method get_deposited_volume], the volume (m³) of mud clods that stuck to vehicles' bodies instead of landing (see [method PhysXVehicle3D.add_mud_splat]).

method.name: kick
method.description: Digs a disc of [param radius] by [param depth] m out of the ground at [param position] and throws it at [param velocity]. Returns the volume, m3 ([code]0[/code] before the solver is ready or off soft ground).

members.member: The node the box follows (a vehicle), its floor a metre under the ground there.
The grains' material. Empty: dry sand. Set before the grains are first thrown.
The [GroundSurface3D] the sand comes from and goes back to. Empty: the active one.
A grain still in the air after this long lands where it is.

Sprays from sticky clay go to an internal grains node of wet clay (1700 kg/m³, 20 degrees, cohesive), drawn as wet clods, which lands back into the ground as this node's sand does. It also throws the clay a [code]PhysXVehicle3D[/code]'s clogged treads shed, up and back off the tyre at the tread's speed. See [method get_mud_grains].
The spread of a throw's velocity, as a share of its speed.
The sand a slipping tread throws, m per metre of slip (to 10 m/s of slip), dug over the sand the tread reaches, its loose rim first. [code]0[/code] throws none.
